method: Partial recovery programme. Flat nominal planning dollars; no inflation, tax, grants, efficiency learning or demand growth. Separate 30-year amortizing loan per capital cohort; payments begin in draw year. Half operating output in commissioning year, full in later years. Operating receipts, costs and replacement reserves scale with active capacity. Construction carrying cost is additional 1%/year of drawn uncommissioned capital. No social benefit or actual import offset calculated. Component lag order: county, manure, wastewater nutrients, three-plant ZLD, industrial food. The ZLD capital is drawn in year 1. Commissioned_fraction and operating_fraction are capital-weighted, not county coverage. No 3D-printing cost or schedule saving is credited.
